# BOLTIV

> BOLTIV (https://boltiv.ng) is a Nigerian digital services and payments platform. With one BOLTIV account and one naira wallet you can buy airtime and data, pay electricity bills, renew DStv and GOtv, buy WAEC, NECO and NABTEB exam PINs, send bulk airtime and bulk SMS, top up phones abroad, create a contactless USD virtual card, and automate payments with AutoPay and Scheduled Payments. BOLTIV also has an Agent programme for people who want to resell supported services at discounted prices.

## Services

- Airtime and data: MTN, Airtel, Glo and 9mobile, paid from the BOLTIV wallet.
- Electricity bills: prepaid and postpaid for IKEDC, EKEDC, AEDC, KEDCO, PHED, IBEDC, EEDC, JED, KAEDCO, BEDC and YEDC. Minimum purchase is 2,000 naira.
- Cable TV: DStv and GOtv subscription renewals.
- Exam PINs: WAEC, NECO and NABTEB.
- Bulk Airtime: up to 50 numbers at once.
- International Top-up: airtime and data for phones in other countries, paid in naira.
- Bulk SMS: send to one or thousands of recipients with an approved sender ID.
- BOLTIV Card: a contactless USD virtual card funded by bank transfer in naira; needs a one-time identity verification.
- AutoPay: automatically repeats Airtime, Data or Cable TV purchases daily, weekly or monthly at 7:00 AM from the wallet.
- Scheduled Payments: buys Airtime, Data or Cable TV once on a chosen future date and time (Nigeria time).
- BOLTIV Agent: discounted BOLTIV prices for resellers; requires at least 10,000 naira in the wallet as working capital and a verified funding account. No guaranteed income.

## How the Maximum Payment works (AutoPay and Scheduled Payments)

- The Maximum Payment is the highest amount a customer allows BOLTIV to charge for one automatic purchase. It must be at least the current price and can be up to 1,000,000 naira.
- Before every automatic payment BOLTIV checks the current price. If the price is within the Maximum Payment, the purchase goes ahead. If it is above, the wallet is not charged and the customer is notified, and the customer can approve the new price.
- BOLTIV suggests a limit: equal to the amount for airtime, and about 10% above the price (rounded up to the next 50 naira) for data and cable TV.
